findings.title: NumPy float32 targets prevent report serialization after the first phase
findings.evidence: Line62 creates zero=np.zeros(2,dtype=np.float32); line105 passes zero to the first settle phase. Line93 stores list(targets), retaining numpy.float32 elements, and line99 appends that item to report. Line101 calls save(), whose line22 json.dumps has no NumPy converter. Standard JSON cannot encode numpy.float32, so this path fails after settle rather than reaching stationary/drive comparison.
findings.cleanup_effect: The unencodable phase remains in report. The unconditional save at line131 also fails before the explicit app.close call at line134. Host Job closure remains required and may close the process, but this probe cannot complete its intended report/close sequence.
findings.minimal_repair: At line93 store wheel_targets_rad_s=[float(v) for v in targets]. Preserve the measured native times, original phase targets and all physical gates.
findings.basis: Source-only reachable-path analysis; not executed or reproduced here.
